upstream_context.artist_meaning_summary: Notice the unseen labor that keeps a shared garden usable, without turning it into praise or a call to action.

emotional_tension_review.intended_feeling_reviewed: modest civic attention that lingers after the article
minimum_tension_criteria_reviewed: The photos must sharpen the unsolved question rather than answer it.
The supporting medium must not restate what the prose already says.

tension_intensity_assessments.assessment_note: The must-not-drift rule blocks praise or a volunteer ask in either medium, so the question stays open in both.

tension_intensity_assessments.tension_name: supporting photos carry a distinct job
tension_intensity_assessments.assessment_note: The shoe photo sits at the hook and the hose photo at the turn, so each photo does evidentiary work the prose only implies.

key_emotional_movements_reviewed.review_note: The shoe-print photo is placed at the hook without explaining the disturbance the prose opens with.
The coiled-hose photo lands at the reframing turn and shows readiness rather than a person.
No photo is planned for the payoff, which keeps the changed noticing in the reader rather than on the page.

expectation_turns_reviewed.review_note: The hook beat stays a question; the photo does not caption an answer.
The turn beat widens to unseen labor and the hose photo supports that widening.
The payoff beat is left to the prose, protecting the lingering attention.

emotional_tension_review.reviewer_conclusion: The Cross-Medium Plan is coherent enough to present for artist approval before the supporting image medium expands.

matched.summary: One unchanged Shared Story Spine and its standing Story Approval are reused by id.

traces_to.note: The plan references the existing Artist Meaning, Transformation Brief, and Beat Plan by id and does not fork the Beat Plan for the image medium.

matched.summary: Exactly one primary medium is named and every other medium is supporting.

traces_to.note: Text carries the primary Medium Role; image is supporting and serves text.

matched.summary: Production order is sequential and medium-local authority stays in the Medium Plans.

traces_to.note: Text is realized first and is required before image; the plan records no simultaneous production.
Form, voice, and length decisions remain in the independently reviewed Text Medium Plan.

findings.summary: Both required inline photos must land or be waived by name before the package can close.
findings.evidence: Both photo deliverables are marked required and both point at the repeating inline_photo Package Format slot.
findings.recommendation: Carry both into the Package Format Selection And Completeness Gate and waive by named slot if either fails to land.

recommended_revision: No blocking revision required before Cross-Medium Plan Approval.
